subject: Sponsor rights, visibility slate, and demo pod scheduling
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@devconevents.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: sponsorships@devconevents.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor package questions — demo pod windows & lounge rights

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for considering DevCon as a partner for Redwood this year — we're excited about the fit. A couple quick items our ops team needs to lock down before we send the final SOW:

- Demo pod scheduling: we need to confirm the 3x 3-hour prime windows you requested and whether Redwood needs exclusivity on the pod during those times.
- Lounge/exec activation rights: your proposal notes "lounge rights" — can you confirm what that entails (signage, staffing, attendee invites) and whether you expect category exclusivity in the lounge?
- Logo placement: the standard package lists a medium logo on the website and small on the stage backdrop. Do you need larger stage billing or on-stage signage?

I've attached the base sponsorship matrix for reference. If you can send a short matrix with the same columns updated to your requests (times, exclusivity, logo sizes), we can expedite internal approvals.

Best,
Elena Morales
Sponsorship Director
DevCon Events

Attachment: sponsorship_matrix_v3.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@devconevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor package questions — demo pod windows & lounge rights

Elena —

Appreciate the clarity. I reviewed the matrix and sketched an updated deliverables slate that should map to the ask. High level:

- Demo pod: we can commit to the three 3-hr prime windows on Day 1 (11a–2p), Day 2 (12p–3p), Day 3 (10a–1p). We'd like a 15-minute buffer before/after for quick reset and queue control.
- Exclusivity: category exclusivity in the demo pod is important to our commercial team. Open to paying an exclusivity uplift if DevCon requires it — please let me know the rate.
- Lounge rights: by "lounge rights" we mean: one branded lounge banner (backdrop panel), 50 VIP passes for sponsored invites, and ability to schedule two 20-minute hosted conversations in the lounge programming. We are not asking for full venue exclusivity.
- Logo placement: we want a larger stage-side vertical banner and priority logo on the digital sponsor carousel (medium+). We'll provide AI/EPS files.

I attached a quick redline of your matrix with the cells filled in (sponsorship_matrix_v3_redline). If you can confirm the exclusivity uplift and that the stage banner placement is available, we can authorize design to prep assets.

Thanks —
Aditya
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sponsorship_matrix_v3_redline.xlsx
From: Elena Morales <elena@devconevents.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: sponsorships@devconevents.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor package questions — demo pod windows & lounge rights

On Tue, Jun 9, 2026 at 10:05 AM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena —
> 
> Appreciate the clarity. I reviewed the matrix and sketched an updated deliverables slate that should map to the ask. High level:
> 
> - Demo pod: we can commit to the three 3-hr prime windows on Day 1 (11a–2p), Day 2 (12p–3p), Day 3 (10a–1p). We'd like a 15-minute buffer before/after for quick reset and queue control.

Thanks, Aditya — this helps. A few follow-ups from Ops:

1) The Day 1 11a–2p and Day 2 12p–3p are in our prime walk path and are okay, Day 3 10a–1p is lower-traffic; if you want higher visibility that day we can swap to 11a–2p but that blocks other sponsors.
2) Exclusivity: we can offer category exclusivity on the demo pod for +$7,500 and category exclusivity for the lounge for +$10,000. Both are requested on a per-event basis (not multi-event).
3) Stage banner: we have limited vertical banner slots; one medium vertical at stage-right is available. For a larger stage runway placement we need the stage rider approval (attached) and an additional production fee.

I'll loop legal on the exclusivity language once you confirm you want to proceed. Also, we need final logos and a stage-ready banner proof by Jun 18 to make the print queue for on-site.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: stage_rider.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@devconevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor package questions — demo pod windows & lounge rights

Elena —

Thanks for the options. We'd like to take both category exclusivity add-ons (pod + lounge) for the event — please proceed with the +$17,500 uplift combined.

Action items on our side:
- Marissa will prepare the stage vertical artwork and digital carousel assets; we'll send AI/EPS files and a banner proof by Jun 17 (one day ahead of your deadline).
- Confirmed demo pod windows: Day 1 11:00–14:00, Day 2 12:00–15:00, Day 3 11:00–14:00 (swap requested). Please confirm swap on Day 3.

Marissa — can you confirm whether we need a hard banner template from Ops or if the logo_spec.ai will be sufficient?

Aditya

Attachment: logo_spec.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@devconevents.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor package questions — demo pod windows & lounge rights

Aditya / Elena —

Quick note: Ops typically wants a stage template for physical banners (dimensions + bleed). Elena, if you can share the stage banner spec I will lay into our artwork. If you prefer, I can use the attached logo_spec.ai as a starting point but will need final dimensions by EOD Friday.

Kimberly, please advise if we should have Legal draft a short exclusivity clause for the SOW (1–2 sentences) and whether we can approve the $17,500 uplift in our regional budget this month.

Marissa
Senior Designer, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@devconevents.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor package questions — demo pod windows & lounge rights

Marissa / Aditya —

Please proceed. Legal should include this sentence for the exclusivity add-on: "Sponsor shall receive category exclusivity for the demo pod and lounge for the event date(s) listed in the SOW; exclusivity is granted on a per-event basis and does not apply to subsequent events."

Aditya, budget ok to cover $17,500 uplift under marketing discretionary (DC-2026-SPONS-119). I'll have a short PO addendum routed today; Elena, expect a signed addendum by EOD Thu.

Kimberly Park
Director, Partnerships & Events
Redwood Inference
